::: {.notes}
The second embedded demonstration, Demo2.mp4, showcases the model in an animated sequence. The repository does not publish the input prompt, references or generation settings. The local file contains the complete roughly 20-second video, reduced to 1024 pixels wide.

- **T2V preference Elo: 1173 Elo**. Text prompt; audio enabled. Independent preference benchmark. [Source](https://artificialanalysis.ai/video/leaderboard/text-to-video).

- **I2V preference Elo: 1127 Elo**. Source image; audio enabled. Independent preference benchmark. [Source](https://artificialanalysis.ai/video/leaderboard/image-to-video).

- **Editing preference Elo: 1200 Elo**. Instruction-based video editing; audio kept. Independent preference benchmark. [Source](https://artificialanalysis.ai/video/leaderboard/video-editing).
